{{Quote|Mr. Solo, I am ''Brother Xando''. My sect and I are on a pilgrimage to ''Norclune'', the holy planet. We seek passage on your ship.|Xando|<ref name="Tales14" />}}
'''Norclune'''<ref name="Tales14" /> was located in the [[Norclune system/Legends|Norclune system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="TEA Norclune" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{Talesstart}}
[[File:NorcluOrder-SmugglersBlues.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Members of the Norclu Order underwent a pilgrimage to Norclune.]]
It was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was considered a holy world by the [[Norclu Order]].<ref name="Tales14" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Smuggler's Blues]]" takes place concurrently with the portion of {{Film|IV}} that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> a group of [[Xando's species|alien]] members of the order, including [[Gender/Legends|Brother]] [[Xando]], sought passage from<ref name="Tales14" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> as part of a pilgrimage to Norclune. To that end, Xando and their fellow members of the Norclu Order approached the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in Tatooine's [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]]. Xando expressed their hope that Solo would provide the group with passage to Norclune for free as a gift to the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]], and the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] further proclaimed that both the smuggler and<ref name="Tales14" /> his<ref name="TEA" /> [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|starship]] would receive blessings after arrival at their destination. Solo, however, countered with a claim that the lengthy trip would be [[Currency/Legends|costly]] as well as an expression of his lack of belief in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and the smuggler refused the request.<ref name="Tales14" />
{{Talesend}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SmugglersBlues.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Norclune was introduced in the comic story "Smuggler's Blues."]]
Norclune was mentioned in "[[Smuggler's Blues]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by the [[Fillbach Brothers]] and included in the [[Star Wars Tales 14|fourteenth]] issue of the comic book series ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' by [[Dark Horse Comics]],<ref name="Tales14" /> published on [[December 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53992/star_wars_tales_1999_14|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) 14}}</ref> Plausible stories in the [[Star Wars Tales 1|first]] through [[Star Wars Tales 20|twentieth issue]] of ''Star Wars Tales'' were deemed [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref name="SWB">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref>

[[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref> co-author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent planets or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the existence of Norclune to be canonical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Fry" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Norclune system in grid square L-8.<ref name="TEA Norclune" />
